Eleventh reviewer round 2026-05-30: re-enumerated C8 Category (b) `infra/modules/*` runtime wrappers to add six #334 wrappers — ske-foundation-cluster-wrapper, stackit-secrets-manager-wrapper, eso-cluster-secret-store-wrapper, logme-worm-retention-wrapper, factory-egress-networkpolicy-wrapper, factory-bot-identity-wrapper — covering the SKE foundation cluster + Secrets Manager + ESO + WORM-retention LogMe + egress NetworkPolicy + bot identity provisioning surface required by FR-019's two-emitter rule (the orchestrator and webhook handler need the SKE cluster, secrets, and egress posture before they can run).
